notes: The sheet contains eight upright formula groups and a cancelled opposite-direction calculation: determinant; three paired delta systems; etc; four-line prose paragraph; final paired delta system. The isolated dot beside On is separately preserved.
No title, date, authorial page count or manuscript page number was read. The pencilled archive 5 at the upright lower left is retained solely as a comment.
No authorial uncertainty phrase was found. The open P( fragment, lowest open parenthesis/final plus and range ending in a second ≤ are unfinished written material and remain unfinished.

The two long diagonals pass approximately from (194,190) to (1104,1614) and from (954,80) to (438,1600). They cancel the opposite-direction layer; its complete underlying writing is transcribed with deletion state. H already describes this overall cancellation in apparatus, so it is not counted as a missing H cancellation.
H editorial note and the two layer captions, including its statement about the previous page and f=P/Q, are treated as descriptive apparatus; they are not counted as manuscript prose.

The first Q factor in the long numerator is live at the base. Crossings concentrate at the raised 2, whose local cancellation state remains qualified. No algebraic reduction was performed to choose the reading.

The lower fraction rule is retraced over part of its right-middle length, and the last small quotient rule has a hooked return at the right tip. Those physical features are documented in reading.tex comments; no extra algebraic symbol is supplied.

The product exponent 2/two-primes, the denominator exponent 3/4, the lowercase p, the literal dash after the determinant and the unequal prose indices were read from their local strokes. No formula was repaired from a familiar identity.

The original C.tex has 25 actual unsure markers. Eleven are resolved here and fourteen retained. The notation-table entries and the non-uncertain note about e(d-1) were not converted into invented C doubts.

The 21 crops are shared only by adjoining targets or by the two distinct writing layers at their own loci. No decided locus was cropped again. An uncertain crop reading was retained as uncertain without a second crop.

H omission of the whole long fraction and lowest fragment is recorded once for each complete display. Subsequent C-only qualification rows explicitly cross-reference those display omissions and do not count them a second time.
The array columns in reading.tex place the vertical equal signs between their left members. This is a rendering choice for the already-present C signs, not a macro-only collation difference.
No mathematical proof, substitution, symbolic derivation or computational identity check was performed. check_events is empty.

Final artifact checks: JSON parsed; all 21 crop references exist; all difference boxes lie within the full scan; 17 unsure markers match 17 reported remaining doubts; the 11/14 C resolution/retention counts match all 25 original markers; TeX braces/display delimiters/array environments balance. These are document checks, not mathematical check events.
